'''Michael Bühl''' is a professor of [[Computational chemistry|Computational and Theoretical Chemistry]] in the School of Chemistry, [[University of St Andrews|University of St. Andrews]]. == Biography ==
Bühl was born in 1962.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://chemistry.st-andrews.ac.uk/staff/buehl/group/|title=Michael Bühl @ School of Chemistry, University of St. Andrews|website=chemistry.st-andrews.ac.uk|access-date=2017-04-13}}</ref> He earned his PhD at the [[University of Erlangen-Nuremberg]]'s Institute for Organic Chemistry (Institut für organische Chemie), where his thesis advisor was [[Paul von Ragué Schleyer]]. In 1992, he worked as a [[Postdoctoral researcher|post-doctoral researcher]] with [[Henry F. Schaefer, III|Henry F. Schaefer III]] ([[University of Georgia]]). He was an Oberassistent at the Institute of Organic Chemistry, [[University of Zurich|University of Zürich]] between 1993 and 1999. In 1999, he also worked at [[Max Planck Institute for Coal Research|Max-Planck-Institut für Kohlenforschung]], [[Mülheim]]. He was on the faculty at the [[University of Zurich|University of Zürich]] from 1998 to 2000 and then at [[University of Wuppertal]] from 2000 to 2008. He is Chair of Computational Chemistry at the [[University of St Andrews|University of St. Andrews]] since 2008.

== Research interests ==
Bühl's group applies the tools of [[Computational chemistry|computational quantum chemistry]] to study a variety of chemical and biochemical systems and their properties, focussing on [[Transition metal|transition-metal]] and [[Block (periodic table)|f-element]] chemistry, [[Homogeneous catalysis|homogeneous]] and [[Biocatalysis|bio-catalysis]], and [[Nuclear magnetic resonance|NMR]] properties. The methods employed are mostly rooted in [[Density functional theory|density-functional theory]] (DFT), including [[Quantum mechanics|quantum-mechanical]]/[[Molecular mechanics|molecular-mechanical]] ([[QM/MM]]) calculations and first-principles [[molecular dynamics]] simulations.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://risweb.st-andrews.ac.uk/portal/en/persons/michael-buehl(dbfea43c-12f5-4f47-8ac4-1f556060020f).html|title=Michael Buehl - University of St Andrews|website=risweb.st-andrews.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2017-04-13}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eastchem.ac.uk/newsandevents/video/prof-michael-buehl-research-nutshell|title=Prof. Michael Buehl - Research in a Nutshell {{!}} EaStCHEM|website=www.eastchem.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2017-04-13}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=EaStCHEM Research School of Chemistry|title=Michael Buehl|date=2014-04-16|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=esEl_xidYW0|accessdate=2017-04-13}}</ref>
